statement: The pinned Codex App Server accepts JSON-RPC requests and notifications over selectable stdio, Unix-socket, or WebSocket transports and dispatches typed requests through dedicated processors.

display_text.zh-CN: 固定版本的 Codex App Server 可通过 stdio、Unix socket 或 WebSocket 接收 JSON-RPC request/notification，并把类型化请求分派给专用 processor。
display_text.en: The pinned Codex App Server accepts JSON-RPC requests and notifications over selectable stdio, Unix-socket, or WebSocket transports and dispatches typed requests through dedicated processors.

evidence.title: Codex App Server runtime and transports

notes: Wire compatibility, reconnect behavior, and client interoperability have not been reproduced by this project.
